title: Coordinate expectation
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and a coordinate $i$, define its coordinate expectation by averaging the two values obtained by setting coordinate $i$ to $1$ and to $-1$, while leaving all other coordinates fixed. This operation is linear in $f$.
